title: MIA: Memory In Intelligence Agent Framework
summary: A specialized memory management system for deep research AI agents that utilizes a three-tier Manager-Planner-Executor architecture. It optimizes long-context reasoning by shifting from passive storage to active strategic planning using Continual Test-Time Learning.
research_notes: Jointly developed by ECNU and the Shanghai Institute of Intelligence to address context bloat in complex research workflows.

evolution.summary: Updated in April 2026 with streaming TTRL for real-time strategy adjustment and released as a skill on Clawhub. The codebase now provides a complete training pipeline using veRL along with pre-trained models and benchmarks.
